register.labelZh: DRAG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: drag on 表示事情本身持續得太久;drag something out 則表示某人或某個行動令事情持續得太久。；drag somebody off 可以表示某人不情願地被帶走;drag yourself away 可以表示自己捨不得停止一項喜歡的活動。；drag somebody in 或 drag somebody into something 可以描述某人被牽涉進事情;dragsomebody or something down 則可以描述情緒、行為、質素或表現受到拖累。；當某人重提過去、尷尬或令人不快的事情時,可以使用 drag something up。
register.summaryEn: Drag on describes something that continues for too long. Drag something out shows that a person or action makes it last too long. Drag somebody off can show that a person is made to go somewhere unwillingly. Drag yourself away can show that you find it difficult to stop an enjoyable activity. Drag somebody in or into something describes unwanted involvement. Drag somebody or something down describes a harmful effect on mood, behaviour, quality or performance. Drag something up is useful when somebody mentions an old, embarrassing or unpleasant subject again.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；留意以下兩個表達的分別:● The meeting dragged on.會議本身持續得太久。● The speaker dragged the meeting out.講者令會議持續得太久。；先學習核心表達。額外的字詞可以補充資料,但並不是核心表達的固定部分。例如,to the office 只補充某人被帶到哪裏;from the screen 只補充某人離開甚麼。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Notice the difference between these two expressions: ● The meeting dragged on. The meeting itself continued for too long. ● The speaker dragged the meeting out. The speaker caused the meeting to continue for too long. Learn the core expression first. Extra words may add useful information, but they are not fixed parts of the expression. ● drag somebody off ● drag somebody off to the office ● drag somebody away ● drag somebody away from the screen When using him, her, it or them, follow these models: ● drag him off ● drag it down ● drag them in ● drag her away ● drag it out ● drag it up

questions.answerZh: 他不停抱怨,拖低了整個小組的情緒。

questions.promptZh: 講者加入許多冗長故事,令演講持續得更久。
